name: acclaim-batman
notes: Every other ranking feature is structural, so a landmark and a competent forgotten book of the same shape scored the same: before acclaim existed, Batman: Journey Into Knight led at 0.887 and The Long Halloween sat third at 0.873, both being twelve-ish self-contained issues titled after Batman starting at #1. Acclaim is the only signal that comes from outside the catalog. The Long Halloween carries an Eisner recorded in Wikidata; Year One and Hush are runs inside the ongoing title, so they depend on curated entries and on the candidate pool not truncating them.
